Did the Polish state or its government-i.question: Did the Polish state or its government-in-exile formally collaborate with Nazi Germany?
Did the Polish state or its government-i.answer: No, there was no puppet government and the Polish state/government-in-exile never surrendered or formally collaborated with Germany.

What scale of individual Polish collabor.question: What scale of individual Polish collaboration with the occupier does the article describe?
What scale of individual Polish collabor.answer: Individual collaboration was less organized and marginal compared to other countries, with estimates ranging from 7,000 to hundreds of thousands depending on definition, and Madajczyk estimating about 5% of the population actively collaborated.

What role does the article attribute to.question: What role does the article attribute to Poles in the deaths of Jews under occupation?
What role does the article attribute to.answer: The article attributes the extermination of Jews to Nazi Germany as an explicit goal, while criticizing Poles for indifference to the Jewish plight, describing this as 'structural complicity' rather than direct killing.
What role does the article attribute to.value: Structural complicity/indifference (extermination attributed to Nazi Germany)
What role does the article attribute to.evidence: الهدف الصريح المتمثل في إبادة اليهود البولنديين، الذي نفذته ألمانيا النازية في الأراضي البولندية المحتلة... فهو ينتقد نفس السكان بسبب عدم اكتراثهم بالمحنة اليهودية، وهي ظاهرة يسميها «التواطؤ الهيكلي».
